# Memory

Structured records of decisions made, facts observed, and rules in force for this scope. Filenames carry type via subfolder plus slug and id; there is no maintained index file.

Local convention: plant-level facts go under `context/`, not `decisions/` — the co-op's plant managers rotate the operational calls too often for those to hold as decisions.
